en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white photograph of a harbor at sunset, with a large steamship docked, several people standing by the water, warehouses, and a visible clock tower in the distance. The photo caption is in Bulgarian and French, indicating the view is of Varna at sunset. The reverse side contains handwritten Bulgarian text, a Bulgarian postage stamp from the Kingdom era with a portrait of Tsar Boris III, and postmarks. There is also a printed stamp advertising Varna as a sunny beach resort in German ('BESUCHET WARNA SONNIGSTEN BADESTRAND').
